description: Complete console account login, upgrade application, and upgrade execution locally.

machine.previousDescription: This machine has the previous enterprise edition (the Python one), not yet moved to the new enterprise edition.
machine.licensedDescription: This machine has an enterprise licence, not yet moved to the new enterprise edition.
machine.openDescription: Review the current license information, submit applications, and track approval status.
machine.previousNote: The enterprise edition is a separate installer now, and the previous one gets no more releases. The open part keeps upgrading with flocks update; the previous edition's audit logs, security configuration, user management and prompt redaction pages come back with the new enterprise edition.
machine.licensedNote: The licence is kept on this machine; the new enterprise edition takes it over when you upgrade.
machine.openNote: The enterprise edition is a separate installer: it takes this install's data over (moved into its own PostgreSQL on its first start) and is used the same way.

licence.invalidHint: The current license is no longer valid, and the new enterprise edition will not take it over. Renew it first, or contact us to have it issued again.

apply.title: Flocks Pro Upgrade Application
apply.signInFirst: Log in console account before applying for upgrade.

problems.phone: Not a phone number: 6 to 15 digits, a country code starting with +

apply.pendingSubmission: The last submission got no answer from Console, so it may have arrived. Sending again gets it back first; nothing is sent twice.
apply.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this application? You would have to apply again.

upgrade.title: Enterprise updates
upgrade.currentPrevious: This is the previous enterprise edition {{version}}. Check what new enterprise edition Console has for this machine's platform; upgrading downloads and checks it and hands it to its installer, and the service restarts by itself.
upgrade.currentOpen: This is the open edition. Check what new enterprise edition Console has for this machine's platform; upgrading downloads and checks it and hands it to its installer, and the service restarts by itself.
upgrade.whatChanges: After the upgrade the program is in {{root}}, the data stays where it is (moved into the bundled PostgreSQL on the first start; the original is kept) and the machine's licence is carried over; flocks start|stop|restart|status|logs|update work as before.
upgrade.whatChangesWindows: After the upgrade the program is in {{root}} and runs as the FlocksPro Core service, started with the machine; the open edition's data is copied for it (the original stays) and the machine's licence is carried over. Windows asks for an administrator while it installs.
upgrade.systemd: systemd runs this machine (the open edition's offline package): the installer runs as root. The page can download it; then run the command it gives.
upgrade.prepare: {{account}} cannot write {{root}} yet: run this once as root, then come back.
upgrade.loginFirst: Log in console account before checking for a new version.

progress.installing: The installer runs ({{version}}): the open edition stops first, and the enterprise edition's first start moves the data, which can take a few minutes. This page reloads once it is done.
progress.restarting: The open edition has stopped and the enterprise edition is starting for the first time (moving the data). The page reloads if it listens on this address; otherwise open the address the installer printed.
progress.finished: The new enterprise edition {{version}} is installed; reload the page.
progress.failed: The install did not finish and the open edition keeps running; the installer output below says why.
progress.command: The installer is downloaded. Run, as root:
progress.commandPrepare: The installer is downloaded. First let this account have the install directory (as root), then run the installer:

errors.wentBack: The last upgrade did not finish, so this machine went back to the version it had before. Its data and its service are intact. To try again, click the new-version mark next to the version at the bottom left.
errors.load: Could not read this machine's state
errors.login: Could not start the Console sign-in
errors.logout: Could not log out of the console account

callback.missingConsoleLoginId: console_login_id is missing; the sign-in cannot be finished.
